about:
Michelsen Packaging Co. was founded in 1937 in Fresno, California, as a manufacturer and distributor of protective packaging for fresh produce. The company remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed. Its founder established a philosophy of exceptional customer service that continues to guide operations.

The company produces a range of packaging materials including Jiffy® macerated produce pads, Kushion Kraft®, Bubble Wrap®, Cell-Aire® polyethylene foam, embossed tissue, diaper pads, and soaker pads. It also manufactures raisin trays under the SUN-DRY® and SUNBEAM® brands and continuous raisin paper rolls. Michelsen describes itself as the valley’s oldest and largest manufacturer and distributor of these products, though facility size and headcount are not published.

Primary customers are growers, packers, and shippers of fresh fruits and vegetables such as peaches, plums, nectarines, apricots, apples, pears, grapes, asparagus, and berries. The company also serves the raisin industry with tray and roll products. Its market focus is the Central Valley agricultural sector.

Michelsen cites its founder’s credo — “Exceptional customer service continues as our number one goal” — as the principle that differentiates it. The firm also notes its status as the “#1 choice of valley growers for Continuous Raisin Paper Rolls.”
